P-TEM-03.summary: The flagship appliance: AI-accelerated threat detection in a box, with a 7-inch touch screen.

sections.heading: Features
items: Network segmentation, so devices sit on separate networks
Built on IT7Q's own Australian-designed board

sections.heading: Who it's for
items: Made for home offices and small businesses that want serious protection

sections.heading: The range
paragraphs: Five tiers, from T1 Scout to T5 Citadel, priced from $149 to $1,499. T1 to T4 are built on IT7Q's own Australian-designed carrier board, around a Raspberry Pi compute module, with AI-accelerated threat detection on the higher tiers.
